objectives: Prepare and carry out a notarial will with two witnesses.
Accept a holographic will for safekeeping and return it to the testator.
Announce a holographic will after the testator's death and issue copies.
Enter the announced will and register the data that the law requires.
Handle the documents for a sale or partition of inherited property.

cards.front: Who may make a notarial will?
cards.back: Only the **notary personally**; not an assistant notary ([[znnd:40:1]]).

cards.front: How many witnesses does a notarial will need?
The testator's daughter, who inherits under the will, offers to be a witness. May she?
cards.back: **No**: a person in whose favour the act contains a disposition cannot be a witness, nor can a close relative ([[gpk:584::3|Art. 584 items 3]] and [[gpk:584::4|4 ГПК]]).

cards.front: What if the testator cannot sign a notarial will?
cards.back: The testator states the **reason**, and the notary records it **before reading** the will ([[zn:24:3]]).

cards.front: What is the deadline to present a notarial will to the registration judge?
What is entered in the information system about wills?
cards.back: The **name and ЕГН of the testator** ([[n32:9а::3|Art. 9а item 3 Наредба № 32]]).

cards.front: How is a holographic will deposited?
cards.back: In a **closed envelope**; the notary writes a protocol on the envelope, signed by the depositor and the notary ([[zn:25:2]]).

cards.front: The testator's son asks for his father's deposited will. May the office give it to him?
cards.back: **No**: only the **testator personally** may take it back, with a note in the register signed by the testator, two witnesses and the notary ([[zn:26]]).

cards.front: Which notary announces a deposited holographic will?
A niece presents her late aunt's holographic will. Who signs the announcement protocol?
cards.back: The **niece**, as the person who presented the will, and the **notary**; both countersign every page of the will ([[zn:27:3]]).

cards.front: Is a copy of an announced will entered in the property register?
cards.back: **Yes**, when it concerns real estate ([[pv:4|Art. 4]](к) ПВ).

cards.front: What is the fee for a notarial will?
cards.back: **50%** of the [[tarifa:8|item 8]] fee, at least 30 лв. = 15.34 € ([[tarifa:9|item 9 ТНТ]]).

quiz.question: A testator asks the assistant notary to write her will while the notary is at a meeting. What is right?
options: Refuse; only the notary personally makes a notarial will
Proceed, with two witnesses present at the writing
Proceed, if the notary signs the will later that day
Proceed, as a holographic will deposited with the notary
quiz.explanation: [[znnd:40:1]]: the assistant notary may perform the acts of the notary except, among others, notarial wills. A will written by the notary's staff and signed later by the notary does not meet [[zn:24]]; a holographic will must be written by hand by the testator ([[zn:25:1|Art. 25(1)]]).

quiz.question: The testator's daughter, who inherits under the will, offers to be a witness. Can she?
options: No; a beneficiary cannot be a witness
Yes, if she is an adult and literate
Yes, if the testator agrees in writing
Yes, but only as one of the two witnesses
quiz.explanation: [[gpk:584]]: persons in whose favour the act contains a disposition (item 4) and relatives of the participants under [[gpk:575|Art. 575]] (item 3) cannot be witnesses. The consent of the testator does not remove the bar.

quiz.question: In what order are the steps of a notarial will?
options: Statement, writing, reading, note of formalities, signatures
Signatures, writing, reading, note of formalities, statement
Writing by the testator, reading by the notary, signatures
Dictation by the witnesses, writing, signatures, reading
quiz.explanation: [[zn:24:2]]: the testator states the will orally, the notary writes it as stated, reads it to the testator before the witnesses, notes the formalities with the place and date, and then the will is signed by the testator, the witnesses and the notary.

quiz.question: A holographic will is deposited in a sealed envelope. Does the notary read it?
options: No; the notary writes a protocol on the envelope
Yes, to check the validity of the will
Yes, and keeps a copy in the special book
Only when the testator is over 80 years old
quiz.explanation: [[zn:25:2]]: the will is deposited in a closed envelope; the notary writes a protocol on the envelope, signed by the depositor and the notary, and enters it in a special register. The will stays closed; its validity is a matter for the heirs and the court after the announcement.

quiz.question: The testator's son asks to take back his father's deposited will "for safekeeping at home". What is the answer?
options: No; only the testator personally can take it back
Yes, with a power of attorney from the father
Yes, with two witnesses and a note on the envelope
Yes, after the fee for the return is paid
quiz.explanation: [[zn:26:1]]: a deposited holographic will may be taken back only by the testator personally; [[zn:26:2|Art. 26(2)]]: the return is noted in the special register with the signatures of the testator, two witnesses and the notary. A power of attorney does not replace the personal act.

quiz.question: A woman finds her late aunt's holographic will in a drawer. What must she do?
options: Ask a notary to announce it as soon as possible
Keep it until all the heirs agree to the announcement
Take it to the municipality of the aunt's last address
File it with the district court of the aunt's address
quiz.explanation: [[zn:27:1]]: the person who holds a holographic will must ask a notary to announce it at once after learning of the death. [[zn:27:2|Art. 27(2)]]: an interested person may ask the district judge to set a term for presenting the will; the court does not announce it.

quiz.question: Who signs the protocol of announcement of a holographic will?
options: The person who presented the will and the notary
All the heirs of the testator and the notary
Two witnesses and the notary who announces it
The registration judge and the notary
quiz.explanation: [[zn:27:3]]: the notary announces the will in a protocol that describes its condition and its opening; the protocol is signed by the person who presented the will and by the notary, who also countersign every page of the will.

quiz.question: An announced will leaves a flat in Burgas to a niece. What happens with the copy?
options: It is entered in the property register in Burgas
Nothing; a will is never entered in a register
It is entered in the Commercial Register in Sofia
It is sent to the municipality of Burgas only
quiz.explanation: [[pv:4|Art. 4]](к) ПВ: copies of announced wills concerning real estate or rights in real estate are entered, at the registry office of the property's location. A universal will needs a declaration of the beneficiary about the properties in the district.

quiz.question: What does the notary enter in the information system after a holographic will is deposited?
options: The name and identity number of the testator
The full text of the will, as a scanned copy
The names of the heirs named in the will
Nothing; wills are secret until the death
quiz.explanation: [[n32:9а::3|Art. 9а item 3 of Ordinance No. 32]]: the notary enters the name and ЕГН of the testator of a notarial will, of a revocation and of a deposited, returned or announced holographic will. The notary also informs the registration judge of the name within 3 days ([[n32:21:3|Art. 21(3)]]).

quiz.question: How is a notarial will revoked?
options: By a new will, or by a notarial deed that revokes it
By tearing the testator's copy of the will at home
By a letter of the testator to the notary who made it
By telling the heirs, in front of two witnesses
quiz.explanation: [[zn:38]]: a will is revoked expressly by a new will or by a notarial deed in which the testator expressly revokes the earlier dispositions in whole or in part. The notary presents the deed of revocation to the registration judge within 3 days ([[n32:21:2]]).

quiz.question: A holographic will was deposited with notary A. After the death, the heirs ask notary B to announce it. What does notary B do?
options: Refers them to notary A, who keeps the will
Asks notary A to send the will, and announces it
Announces it from the data in the information system
Announces it with two witnesses from the heirs
quiz.explanation: [[zn:27:4]]: when the will was deposited with a notary, the announcement is made by the notary who keeps it. The information system holds only the name and ЕГН of the testator ([[n32:9а::3|Art. 9а item 3 Наредба № 32]]), not the will.

quiz.question: A notarial will was made with one witness. What is its status?
options: Null; a notarial will needs two witnesses
Valid; one witness is enough when the notary knows the testator
Voidable; an heir may challenge it within a year
Valid, if the testator signed every page of the will
quiz.explanation: [[zn:24:1]]: a notarial will is made before two witnesses; [[zn:42|Art. 42]](б): a disposition is null when the rules of [[zn:24|Art. 24]] were not observed. The notary's knowledge of the testator does not replace a witness.
